blocks.heading: Distribution channels and e-commerce
blocks.text: A direct channel supplies from producer to customer without an intermediary taking that selling role. Indirect routes may include producer to retailer to consumer, or producer to wholesaler to retailer to consumer. Wholesalers can buy in bulk and supply smaller quantities to retailers; retailers provide customer access and service. E-commerce can support direct orders or sales through an intermediary platform. Online contact does not remove storage, payments, returns or physical delivery. Describe who sells to whom and distinguish that route from road, rail or another movement method.

blocks.heading: Putting the idea to work
blocks.text: Fictional Oru Bags sells some items directly at its workshop and others through local shops. The workshop sale is direct; producer to shop to household is indirect. An online direct order still needs a collection or delivery arrangement and does not automatically become indirect because a carrier transports it.
